# ultimate-seo-geo

Curated by Skill Harbor: the definitive SEO and GEO audit agent, a framework of 26 procedures that takes a website from scored audit to action plan to execution. It covers technical health, E-E-A-T content scoring, domain signals, schema and structured data, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, robots.txt, sitemaps, hreflang, backlinks, local SEO, site migrations, and Generative Engine Optimization for AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity, with a toolbox of Python scripts for each area and strict evidence rules: no metric is claimed without measured data. It works in three modes, Audit then Plan then Execute, with Internal Mode for your own site (scored /100 Health Score) and Competitive Mode for external sites (labeled External Observation Only, no score). It is LLM-agnostic and works on any platform that reads AGENTS.md: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Aider, Devin. By @mykpono, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via github.com/topics/ai-skills. Honest caveats: a full audit is token-heavy (50k+ tokens) and should be scoped when context is limited; some scripts need optional Google API credentials (PageSpeed, Search Console); scores are only valid on sites you own; this is about organic search, not paid ads or social strategy. Positioning note: the sibling skill in this same batch, Bhanunamikaze/Agentic-SEO-Skill, is a deterministic, command-driven LLM-first audit skill (seo audit <url>) with 16 sub-skills, 10 specialist agents...
